_comment_lockfile: This repo is npm workspaces (shared, backend) with ONE root package-lock.json.
Renovate edits a workspace's package.json and updates the root lock as a
SEPARATE step; when that step fails it still opens the PR, which then cannot
install at all — `npm ci` refuses on a lock that does not satisfy
package.json. That is what happened to @simplewebauthn/server 13.3.3 -> 14.0.0.
npmDedupe makes Renovate run npm against the lock after the edit rather than
relying on the version-rewrite alone, and lockFileMaintenance re-resolves the
whole lock on a schedule so drift does not accumulate silently between bumps.
_comment_pin: Dependencies here are pinned to exact versions (see backend/package.json).
Saying so explicitly keeps Renovate from reintroducing ^ ranges on a major,
which is how a lock and a package.json drift apart without anyone editing both.
